title: Seeds, Germination and Life Cycles
summary: What seeds need to sprout, a fair test with bean seeds, and the life cycles of plants, frogs and mosquitoes.

ib.note: Plant growth responses follow in MYP 3–4

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 10: Living Creatures: Exploring their Characteristics

objectives: I can identify the conditions seeds need to germinate: water, air and suitable temperature.
I can plan and interpret a fair test on germination.
I can describe the life cycles of a plant and an animal.
misconceptions: Tadpoles and frogs are different animals.
